title: jam-actions-v1-probe — evaluation companion to jam-actions-v1 (near-gate acoustic takes; not a version of the corpus)
description:
24 acoustic takes on jam-actions-v1's three held-out songs, each measured within 10 ms or 5 cents of a grading gate, both signs of both quantities. Never split, never trained on. Distinguishes a model that compares a measurement to a gate from one that reads a sign.

This record is an evaluation companion to jam-actions-v1 (10.5281/zenodo.22675239), not a version of the training corpus. It was deposited as a version under the jam-actions concept record; the concept DOI should not be read as pointing at this set. Cite this record by its own DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.22675251.

Rules: never merge these records into a training set; never split them. If you train on the companion corpus and report on this set, say which seed and report every seed. Hugging Face mirror: mcp-tool-shop/jam-actions-v1-probe. Source and results: mcp-tool-shop-org/ai-jam-sessions.
notes: Evaluation-only companion to jam-actions-v1 (10.5281/zenodo.22675239); not a version of the training corpus. Cite this record's own DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.22675251, not the jam-actions concept DOI. Never merge into a training set. Never split.
